observations.behavior: Adds a conditional close of the side panel before redirecting to the insight edit page.
observations.code_quote: return insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId as InsightShortId) : urls.insights()
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to return to the insight edit page while closing the side panel, rather than remaining in the side panel. This could help avoid confusion or redundant navigation, but the benefit depends on the broader context of the side panel and the insight edit page.
